sitio.nombre: Foro Internacional de Música Nueva Manuel Enríquez
sitio.descripcion: Application platform for the calls of the Foro Internacional de Música Nueva Manuel Enríquez.
sitio.desarrollo: Development environment · the data shown is for demonstration only

inicio.encabezado: Foro Internacional de Música Nueva Manuel Enríquez
inicio.entrada: Read the terms of each call, fill in your application at your own pace and submit it once it is complete.
inicio.sin_convocatorias: There are no published calls at the moment.
inicio.paso1_texto: We only ask for an email address, your name and a password. The same account works every year.
inicio.paso2_texto: Your application saves itself as you type. You can pick it up another day or from another device.
inicio.paso3_texto: On submission you will receive a PDF receipt by email with your reference number. After submitting you can no longer edit.
convocatoria.sin_bases: The terms of this call are not available yet.
convocatoria.bases_respaldo: The terms of this call are only available in Spanish.
convocatoria.participa_texto: You need an account to apply. You can work over several sessions before submitting.
convocatoria.proxima_texto: Applications are not open yet. In the meantime you can read the terms and create your account.
convocatoria.cerrada_texto: This call no longer accepts applications. If you applied, sign in to view your application.
cuenta.ingresar_entrada: Enter the email address and password of your account.
cuenta.registro_entrada: Your account will serve for this and future editions. Artistic details are requested later, in the application itself.
cuenta.recuperar_entrada: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password. The link is valid for one hour.
cuenta.password_ayuda: At least 10 characters. A long phrase is better than a word with symbols.
cuenta.idioma_ayuda: Emails and your receipt will be sent in this language.
cuenta.acepto_aviso: I have read and accept the
cuenta.sin_verificar: Your email address is not confirmed yet. You can work on your application, but you will not be able to submit it until you confirm it. Look for our message in your inbox, including the spam folder.
cuenta.password_nota: Changing it will sign you out on your other devices.
cuenta.email_nota: The new address will need to be confirmed again. We will notify the previous address of the change.
cuenta.verificar_entrada: Press the button to confirm that this email address is yours.
cuenta.restablecer_entrada: Enter the new password for your account. Saving it will sign you out everywhere.
cuenta.activar_entrada: Choose the password you will use to sign in to the platform.
error.email_invalido: Enter a valid email address, for example name@domain.com.
error.texto_largo: The text is too long (100 characters maximum).
error.password_corta: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
error.idioma_invalido: Choose one of the available languages.
error.aviso_requerido: To create your account you must accept the privacy notice.
error.email_en_uso: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
error.credenciales: The email address or the password is incorrect.
error.bloqueo: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again, or reset your password.
error.email_igual: That is already your account's email address.
error.edicion_numero: The edition number must be an integer greater than zero.
error.edicion_numero_fijo: The edition number can no longer change: it has published calls, and their links and reference numbers depend on it.
error.limite_invalido: The value must be an integer equal to or greater than zero.
error.max_videos: The maximum number of video links must be between 0 and 3.
error.max_obras_requerido: For Composers the maximum number of works must be set, at least 1.
error.etapa_clave: Each stage must be "postulacion", "revision_documental" or "evaluacion", without repeats.
error.etapa_rango: Each stage must end after it starts.
error.etapa_orden: The stages must follow one another in time (applications, document review, evaluation) without overlapping.
error.convocatoria_cerrada: The call is closed or archived: its configuration can no longer be modified.
error.criterios_en_evaluacion: The criteria cannot be changed once the evaluation has started.
error.borrado_solo_borrador: It can only be deleted while the call is a draft.
error.dotacion_solo_compositores: Instrumentations only apply to the call for Composers.
error.clave_invalida: The key must start with a letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores (40 characters maximum).
error.ambito_dotacion: A requirement specific to an instrumentation must have the scope "obra".
error.dotacion_inexistente: The instrumentation does not exist in this call.
error.mimes_invalidos: Specify at least one supported format: image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf, audio/wav, audio/flac or audio/mpeg.
error.tamano_invalido: The maximum size must be between 1 byte and 200 MB.
error.max_archivos: The maximum number of files must be between 1 and 20.
error.escala_invalida: The scale must run from a minimum of zero or more to a maximum greater than the minimum, up to 100.
error.estado_salto: You can only move to the immediately previous or next stage.
error.motivo_requerido: A reason is required to move back a stage.
error.estado_fechas: With the current dates the system would immediately advance the stage again. Adjust the timeline first.
error.publicar_bases: The terms of the call in Spanish are missing.
error.calendario_incompleto: The full timeline is missing: applications, document review and evaluation.
error.sin_dotaciones: The call for Composers needs at least one active instrumentation.
error.sin_revisor: At least one document reviewer must be assigned.
error.jurados_exactos: Exactly three jury members must be assigned.
error.sin_criterios: At least one evaluation criterion is needed.
error.jurados_completos: The call already has three jury members.
error.asignado_postula: This person has an application in this call: they cannot be its jury member or reviewer.
error.perfil_global: The global profile must be "admin_sistema", "coordinacion_nacional" or empty.
aviso.pendiente: The official text of the full privacy notice must be provided by the CNMO. This page is a provisional outline and has no legal validity.
aviso.entrada: The platform processes personal data of private individuals in accordance with Mexico's Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).
aviso.datos_texto: Your account details (email address, name and language) and whatever you enter in your application. CURP, RFC and bank details are not requested.
aviso.finalidad_texto: To receive, review and evaluate your application to the Forum's calls.
aviso.arco_texto: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and objection. The procedure and contact details will be published with the official text.
